Parent issue: #170

Stage: self-merge

## Task

Implement PR 5 for parent issue #170: add opt-in deterministic self-merge after self-approval. First verify the stack state: PR #186 is the intended base, and it should be refreshed onto the latest PR #184 head before this slice proceeds. Add a separate `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_MERGE=false` gate, distinct from `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE`. Add deterministic self-merge workflow/CLI behavior, not an LLM approval route, that verifies the target is an open non-draft PR, the current head matches the self-approved head, Sepo can see a current-head self-approval from the self-approval path, there is no blocking requested-changes state, required checks and mergeability are acceptable, and stack/base state is safe. Extend orchestration so `agent-self-approve -> approved` dispatches self-merge only when `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_MERGE=true`; otherwise preserve the current stop behavior. Preserve `agent-self-approve -> request_changes -> fix-pr`. For v1 stacked safety, merge only when the PR base is the default branch; if stacked on another open PR, post a visible waiting-on-base status instead of merging. Default behavior: enable GitHub auto-merge when checks are pending but requirements are satisfiable, and merge immediately only when GitHub reports the PR currently mergeable. Add focused tests for handoff routing, merge preflight, stale head, draft PR, failed checks, non-default/stacked base waiting status, successful merge or auto-merge, and docs. Do not broaden into unrelated release, review, or approval-policy changes.

## Base

- base_pr: #186
